_comment: Mandatory warm-up. The general block is written into every routine's notes; the per-tier ramp-up sets are force-injected by writer.js so no workout can ever start cold.

general_warmup.title: MANDATORY WARM-UP (8-10 min) - do not skip
steps: 1) 3-5 min easy cardio (bike / row / fast walk) until you break a light sweat
2) Joint prep: 10x shoulder circles, 10x hip circles, 10x ankle rocks, 10x cat-cow
3) Activation: 15x band pull-apart, 15x glute bridge, 10x dead bug per side
4) Ramp-up sets on the loaded lifts are part of the plan - they are marked as warm-up sets, never skip them
